title: Adults with Congenital Heart Defects (ACHD): A Project for Establishing Rehabilitative, Prehabilitative, Preventive, and Health-Promoting Measures with a Focus on Enhancing Health Awareness, Health Literacy, and Participation
summary: The project aims to achieve a long-term improvement in the health status of adults with congenital heart defects (ACHD) and is conducted with the goal of enhancing their health literacy. To this end, rehabilitative, prehabilitative, preventive, and health-promoting measures are to be developed. Additionally, the project focuses on fostering health awareness and health literacy.

interventions.name: Adults with congenital heart defects assessed using a validated and standardized questionnaire at a single measurement time point.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Age ≥ 18 years
• Presence of a congenital heart defect
• Patient at the ACHD center of DHM
• Ability to provide consent
• Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
• Mental, cognitive, or language impairments that prevent the patient from participating in the study
• Refusal to participate in the study
